overview: Camel Creek is a family adventure park near Wadebridge and Padstow, and it’s squarely aimed at younger children: rides, outdoor play, indoor play for wet days and lots of animals to meet. If you’ve got under-10s in tow, it’s the kind of place that buys you a whole day of happy, tired kids.
It mixes outdoor rides and play with all-weather indoor areas, so it’s a decent bet even when the forecast is mixed.

expect.title: Rides and outdoor play
expect.text: A mix of family rides and energetic outdoor play spread across the park.

expect.title: Indoor play
expect.text: All-weather indoor play areas for when it rains or the little ones need a change of scene.

expect.title: Animals
expect.text: Plenty of animals to see, and young animal lovers can book a behind-the-scenes keeper day.

expect.title: Seasonal events
expect.text: Special events run at different times of year, especially in the school holidays.

goodToKnow.label: Tickets
goodToKnow.text: Entry is paid, but a day ticket comes with a free return visit: in the school holidays you can come back within the following week, and the window is a bit longer outside them. Ask in the gift shop before you leave to set it up.

goodToKnow.label: Annual pass
goodToKnow.text: If you live nearby or visit often, there’s an annual pass for unlimited entry.

goodToKnow.label: Stay on site
goodToKnow.text: There’s camping, glamping and lodges at the park, with park entry included while you stay.

week.text: Pencil it in for a mixed-weather day with younger children. Thanks to the free return visit, you could do a morning now and come back for another go later in the week.

tips: Don’t forget to claim your free return visit at the gift shop before you leave.
Pack a change of clothes for younger children: outdoor play and Cornish weather can be a messy mix.
